scope: Read-only review of the two new CI scripts. Zero AST executions, VM calls, native calls, or filesystem primitives executed by reviewer.

findings.assessment: The launcher binds exact common/input-bundle/validator Git blobs, pins the retained B3 size/SHA, retains the original source/reference identities, and checks final source/image disk bytes. The validator executes module bytes from its single pin snapshot.

Paired invocation feeds the prior native workspace, only applies explicit frozen-test resize/private-mutation inputs, then compares exact return, complete output, complete post-workspace and all source/output/workspace canaries. No mask removes fields.

Both VM and paired suites require a nonempty exact loaded/run count and reject failure/error/skip/expected-failure/unexpected-success. Actual native entries must be nonzero. The frozen test bundle and HIA source bodies themselves were not re-audited here.

Compilation uses the original frozen compile_stage/CHILD path; receipt explicitly checks 10 CPU / 256 MiB and original 1 MiB capacity/workspace, runner identity, produced bytes and forbidden-module/source checks. The 20 wall bound is inherited from the pinned original compile_stage; the two-script review did not execute it.

Every restored archive is SHA/GitSHA/size bound. Extraction rejects symlink/hardlink and traversal, rereads regular bytes/modes, and verifies aggregate counts. Newly executed evidence is placed beneath the common output root; historical restored records are not converted to new counts.

The reports explicitly leave ordinary namespace, physical syscall execution and SQLite migration unclosed. Script-level progress requires actual recorded test outcomes; read-only review is not execution qualification.
